how_to_use: Fill in 'measured' for the parameters you measured, leave the others null (null changes nothing), fill the 'specimen' block, then: cd57_manifest merge data/parameters/cd57_nominal.json YOUR_DELTA.json merged.json  and render with --manifest merged.json (cd57_capture_matrix, cd57_render) or build the plugin with -DCD57_MANIFEST=merged.json. Every measured block needs value, unit (the entry's unit), instrument and date; record the instrument range and lead compensation (Sec. 04). Nominal values stay in the file beside the measured ones.

pt_hv_half_winding_rms.hint: AC RMS of ONE half of the high-voltage secondary (centre tap to one anode), unloaded or at stated load; record mains volts and Hz (Sec. 11, 12, 25)

pt_series_resistance_per_half.hint: DC resistance of one HV half-winding plus the reflected primary resistance (Sec. 12)

ot_turns_ratio_full_primary.hint: full-primary : secondary turns ratio from a low-level voltage ratio with the other windings open (Sec. 12)

ot_primary_inductance_full.hint: small-signal inductance of the full primary, secondary open, at a stated frequency and level (Sec. 12)

ot_leakage_inductance_full_ref.hint: leakage inductance referred to the full primary, secondary shorted (Sec. 12)

ot_dcr_primary_half.hint: DC resistance of one primary half (Sec. 12)

ot_core_saturation_flux_per_secondary_tu.hint: ONLY if a saturation measurement exists (Sec. 12, 29: do not assign a law before evidence); switch the option on to use it

pot_total_resistance.hint: end-to-end resistance of the volume/tone pots (Sec. 08)

pot_endpoint_contact_resistance.hint: wiper resistance at the grounded end stop (Sec. 08)

speaker_Le.hint: voice-coil inductance from the complex impedance fit (Sec. 17)

speaker_Mms.hint: moving mass (sets acoustic sensitivity only; no electrical effect when fs, Qms, Qes are given)

speaker_voice_coil_tempco.hint: only if the conductor is verified (Sec. 18)

tone_pot_taper.hint: 11 alpha values at knob 0, 0.1, ..., 1.0, from the 5 nF end (Sec. 08)
